answer_1.quote: To produce definitions for these words, we generated text from GPT-3, primed with input in the format 'word (POS.) -'.

answer_2.quote: For each word w and definition d in the lexicon, we compute the likelihood under GPT-3 of the definition d to follow word w, p(d|w).

answer_3.quote: If GPT-3 were to perform the matching task done by our human subjects, it would choose the option with higher total likelihood.

answer_4.quote: The studies with human subjects were performed on Amazon Mechanical Turk, with workers from the pool of native English speakers...
answer_4.guideline: Users were asked to decide which assignment of definitions to words is a better fit and to rate their confidence on a scale from 0 to 5.
